summary.tldr: Requires mining-rights regulations on territorial lands to include free, prior and informed consent from affected Inuit and other Indigenous peoples, plus protection for surface-right holders.
what_it_does: Authorizes the Governor in Council to make regulations for acquiring mining rights in, under or on territorial lands, and for royalties tied to that acquisition.
Requires those regulations to include free, prior and informed consent from Inuit and any other Indigenous peoples directly affected.
Requires those regulations to protect and compensate holders of surface rights.
summary.background: It changes section 12 of the Territorial Lands Act, which already lets the Governor in Council make regulations about mining rights and royalties on territorial lands.
